name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion take, and what can make it run late?

mainEntity.name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion take, and what can make it run late?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A straightforward conversion may take several working days, but the complete schedule depends on design decisions, inspections, material availability, demolition findings, and whether plumbing or electrical work changes. A project with custom tile, glass, a bench, relocated controls, or repaired framing generally requires more coordination than a simple same-location replacement.

Key factors:
- Permit review and inspection timing can vary by jurisdiction.
- Special-order tile, doors, valves, and accessories may delay installation.
- Waterproofing and setting materials need appropriate curing time.
- Additional work behind the walls may pause the original sequence.

Before booking, ask Elite Remodeling & Design for the anticipated phases, decision deadlines, long-lead materials, and conditions that could change the schedule. Avoid using the shower until the installer confirms that all required materials have cured.
